articles.headline: Anaheim Ducks sign Cutter Gauthier, 22, to six-year contract
articles.description: After creating salary-cap space with the release of Chris Kreider, the Anaheim Ducks on Tuesday signed Cutter Gauthier to a six-year contract, with GM Pat Verbeek saying in a statement that the 22-year-old left wing is "a major part of our young core."
